Not sendable as an offer

Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. We can't meet the request as specified, for two reasons:

- **Group size:** Your group is 30 people. Our largest room, the Loft, holds a maximum of 24, and the Studio holds a maximum of 12.
- **Duration:** You asked for 6 hours. We only offer 4-hour bookings, and we have no price for a longer session.

There is one alternative. You would have to agree to it, and it means giving things up:



| Option | Package | People | Total | What the client gives up |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| 1 | Loft + Lunch | 24 | €852 | duration shortened from 6 hours to the only available 4-hour block; headcount reduced from 30 to at most 24 |

Every option changes a stated requirement and needs the client's explicit consent.



This option is the Loft with lunch for up to 24 people. It gives up two things from your request. The session would be the single 4-hour block instead of 6 hours. The group would be at most 24 people instead of 30. The Loft has a route without stairs, in case anyone in your group needs one.

We can't confirm anything today. Availability for any date has to be checked separately, and nothing is held from this message. Please also note that BrightRoom cannot promise allergen-safe catering. Vegetarian and vegan lunches are available on request.

If the alternative could work for you, please let me know. Please also tell me your preferred date and whether anyone needs wheelchair access, and I will take it from there.

Kind regards
